historical_result_preserved: docs/repeated_internal_comparison_2026-09-21.json and configs/final_internal_comparison_2026-09-21.json are unchanged; their count_unit label was inaccurate
count_rule: one count per unique qualifying fragment record; column five (supporting read pairs including duplicates) is not summed
interval_rule: a fragment record qualifies for region [beg, end) when fragment_start < end and fragment_end > beg; fragment_start >= fragment_end records are ignored
historical_count_mode_retained: read_support (sums column five) is retained only to reproduce the old read-support-weighted representation and must never be relabelled as the corrected measurement

reader.transport: bounded HTTP range; HTTP 206 with consistent Content-Range, size-bounded read, unsafe redirect refused
reader.stream_semantics: decompressed BGZF members concatenated before line splitting so a record spanning two members is one record; bytes beyond the chunk end virtual offset are never parsed
reader.refusal: truncated or corrupt queries are refused before matrix assembly; unknown barcodes are refused unless an explicit drop contract reports the exclusions
reader.empty_region: a successfully queried region with zero overlapping fragments is a valid empty region, distinct from a failed query

independent_validation.oracle: pysam 0.24.1 (bundled HTSlib), isolated environment outside the shared venv
independent_validation.local_fixture: record split across two BGZF members; per-barcode counts agree
independent_validation.agreement: all local and remote cases agree on per-barcode fragment counts

open_before_corrected_run: RNA raw/X representation must be selected and validated before regeneration
acceptance evidence must be consumed before any scientific-claim promotion
